answer: Audited-grader markets: peer review pays here, so the defense targets the reviewers, not just the workers. A beacon pulse assigns each grader random cases padded with seeded canaries - items whose true verdict the chain already knows. A grader whose ratings echo the crowd instead of the canaries is slashed; their trust rating sinks to a nadir that blocks paid review work until they re-earn standing on free cases. Since collusion needs captured graders and every capture risks a canary, buying fake attestations costs more than earning real ones.
